cd /app && python3 -c "
import subprocess
seqs={}; name=None
for line in open('sequences.fasta'):
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('>'): name=line[1:]; seqs[name]=''
    else: seqs[name]+=line
inp=seqs['input']; out=seqs['output']
p=215
INS=out[p:p+39]
comp={'a':'t','t':'a','g':'c','c':'g'}
def rc(s): return ''.join(comp[c] for c in reversed(s))
def tm(s):
    return float(subprocess.run(['oligotm','-tp','1','-sc','1','-mv','50','-dv','2','-n','0.8','-d','500',s],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
Lf=16; Lr=34
fa=inp[p:p+Lf]      # forward anneal
ra=rc(inp[p-Lr:p])  # reverse anneal
A=INS[:19]; B=INS[19:]
fwd=B+fa
rev=rc(A)+ra
print('fwd anneal Tm',round(tm(fa),3),'rev anneal Tm',round(tm(ra),3),'diff',round(abs(tm(fa)-tm(ra)),3))
print('fwd',fwd)
print('rev',rev)
# KLD reconstruction: circular product = inp[:p]+A+B+inp[p:]
recon=inp[:p]+A+B+inp[p:]
print('recon==output',recon==out)
open('primers.fasta','w').write('>primer_pair_1_forward\n'+fwd+'\n>primer_pair_1_reverse\n'+rev+'\n')
print(open('primers.fasta').read())
"
